facts.text: Movie ranches drive Santa Clarita’s economy, earning the valley the nickname “Hollywood North” as films like Django Unchained and Pirates of the Caribbean shoot here.
Old Town Newhall’s Walk of Western Stars, founded in 1981, honors film legends like Roy Rogers and John Wayne along Main Street.
Tesoro Adobe Historic Park, once home to actor Harry Carey, stands as Santa Clarita’s first tourist attraction within the Tesoro del Valle community.
On September 5, 1876, Charles Crocker hammered a ceremonial spike into a railroad tie at Lang Station, completing the Southern Pacific line that linked Los Angeles to San Francisco.
